summary: Reject Controller ownership of pool backup and restore records in the documentation gate

guide.reason: This changes contributor validation and planning history; no operator workflow changes.

api.reason: The documentation checker has no Nex Controller/Core or client-facing API contract.

roadmap.reason: No milestone status or published built/outstanding items change.

state.reason: The checker and its records persist no product state.

verification.method: The regression failed on the original matcher and passed after correction. A later independent review found omitted execution, verification, repository inventory and run-history wording; the added mixed-exception cases failed before the same matcher was extended. The reviewer independently reran all 29 test_check_docs.py tests and check_docs.py --all successfully and found no further issue in the correction. The repository privacy suite passed one test, and git diff --check passed. The initial scoped worktree documentation gate passed nine paths; the final combined rollout gate is assessed separately as other workers finish their records. Historical Controller-owned records were inspected without rewriting their implementation claims. No native recovery or remote CI result is claimed by this tooling change.
